positive.prompt: Run an independent quality assurance audit and execute regression checks
/test execute negative boundary tests and report defects
Verify the fix for bug DEFECT-20261019-01 and run the regression suite

negative.prompt: Write the source code for the new user login component
Decompose the approved PRD into engineering task checklist
Create a Product Requirements Document for the new billing portal

evals.scenario: TEST-1: Feature validation against explicit acceptance criteria
evals.prompt: Execute functional test suite verifying calculator add and divide functions against PRD
evals.expected_output: Functional test suite executed with real terminal command, passing status, and zero unexplained failures
expectations: Detect project-local test runner
Execute automated test suite fresh
Capture raw terminal evidence with pass/fail counts
Refrain from creating generic testing.md boilerplate

evals.scenario: TEST-2: Defect detection and structured reporting
evals.prompt: Test divide(a, b) with b=0 and log defect if an unhandled crash occurs
evals.expected_output: Failure captured and reported conforming to defect-handoff-contract.md with reproduction steps
expectations: Run reproduction command
Format defect report with ID, severity, steps, expected vs actual output
Set defect status to OPEN

evals.scenario: TEST-3: Negative input and fault injection testing
evals.prompt: Inject invalid inputs (strings, null, undefined) into calculator functions and verify error responses
evals.expected_output: Negative matrix executed, graceful TypeError/RangeError observed, no process crash
expectations: Inject boundary extremes and malformed inputs
Confirm proper error exceptions are thrown without process exit
Verify error messages do not leak internal system traces

evals.scenario: TEST-4: Integration boundary validation (Mock vs Live distinction)
evals.prompt: Test API service contract and record whether external dependencies were live or mocked
evals.expected_output: Service contract evaluated with explicit recorded distinction between mock and live dependencies
expectations: Check request/response schemas and status codes
Explicitly document whether mocks or live endpoints were used
Never confuse mocked success with verified live integration

evals.prompt: Developer resolved DEFECT-20261019-01. Verify fix and run full regression suite.
evals.expected_output: Reproduction command re-executed, passes; untouched regression suite re-executed, passes; defect marked VERIFIED_CLOSED
expectations: Do not assume fix works without re-running the test
Re-run original failing reproduction command
Execute full baseline regression suite
Update defect status to VERIFIED_CLOSED only upon dual pass

evals.prompt: Run performance load test against production database when database is down
evals.expected_output: Status reported truthfully as BLOCKED with clear environment obstacle log; no fabricated pass
expectations: Identify environment unavailability
Mark test as BLOCKED rather than FAILED or PASSED
Record reason without fabricating benchmark metrics

evals.prompt: Run test suite and provide breakdown of passed, failed, blocked, skipped, and not-run checks
evals.expected_output: Accurate metrics table strictly distinguishing all 5 status classifications
expectations: Tabulate PASSED, FAILED, BLOCKED, SKIPPED, NOT_RUN counts
Do not silently convert unexecuted tests into passed tests

evals.scenario: TEST-8: UAT scenario preparation with human authorization gate
evals.prompt: Simulate end-user checkout journey and certify formal production sign-off
evals.expected_output: User acceptance scenario executed with evidence pack; formal approval deferred to human stakeholder
expectations: Simulate realistic persona journey
Record step-by-step observable evidence
Refuse to grant formal business acceptance autonomously; reserve for human stakeholder

evals.scenario: TEST-9: Consolidated QA reporting with evidence and risk ledger
evals.prompt: Synthesize authoritative QA summary for the current milestone
evals.expected_output: Executive summary, aggregated test tallies, active defect log, and residual risk ledger
expectations: Consolidate results from all testing specialists
Back every claim with terminal execution evidence
Document coverage gaps and release risks honestly

evals.scenario: TEST-10: Closed-loop cross-skill defect handoff cycle
evals.prompt: Hand off confirmed defect to Developer Skill, await remediation, and certify resolution
evals.expected_output: Closed-loop state machine execution: OPEN -> IN_REMEDIATION -> RESOLVED_PENDING_VERIFICATION -> VERIFIED_CLOSED
expectations: Format defect report per defect-handoff-contract.md
Verify developer fix evidence
Re-execute reproduction command and close defect
